expectations.text: DSL validates cleanly with the Structurizr CLI
expectations.evidence: Grader re-ran `structurizr/structurizr validate -workspace workspace.dsl` from outputs/: exit 0, no error lines. Agent also reported validate + inspect (inspect: only missing !docs/!adrs, reported to user, not fabricated).

expectations.text: Model matches the spec exactly: 1 person; SPA, API, worker, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ as containers of Encurtaí; Google Workspace as external system; nothing invented
expectations.evidence: One person 'Usuário interno'; encurtai has exactly spa (React/nginx), api (Go Gin), worker (Go), db (PostgreSQL 16), cache (Redis 7), fila (RabbitMQ); googleWorkspace external. No extra elements; SSO protocol left as plain HTTPS and raised as a question.

expectations.text: Requested views present: systemContext, container, and a dynamic redirect flow including cache lookup, miss→Postgres, and click-event publish
expectations.evidence: systemContext 'SystemContext', container 'Containers', dynamic 'Redirecionamento' with 4 steps: usuario->api, api->cache, api->db 'Em caso de cache miss', api->fila 'Publica o evento de clique'.

expectations.text: Styles differentiate database (cylinder), queue (pipe), and external system (distinct color)
expectations.evidence: element "Database" { shape cylinder }, element "Queue" { shape pipe }, element "External" { background #999999 } vs default #1168bd.

expectations.text: Modern syntax only (no enterprise/!extend/!ref/branding/theme default/dashed booleans)
expectations.evidence: grep for enterprise|!extend|!ref|branding|theme default|dashed true/false: no matches. Uses !identifiers hierarchical, instance-free model, configuration scope.

expectations.text: Relationship labels are specific and inter-process links carry technology/protocol
expectations.evidence: All 9 relationships have directional verbs ('Publica eventos de clique em', 'Grava métricas agregadas em') and a technology (HTTPS, JSON/HTTPS, SQL/TCP, Redis/TCP, AMQP).
